built_for: 2026 NFL season, weeks 1 to 10 (Week 10 partially played)

settlement_rules.rule: The home side covers when (home points - away points) is strictly greater than the home spread; it fails when strictly less; it is a push when equal.
settlement_rules.tie_case: A tied game is graded against the spread as a normal result; the project does not void it.
settlement_rules.authority: Project grading rule. No operator rule was retrieved, so no operator settlement is claimed.

settlement_rules.rule: The over wins when (home points + away points) is strictly greater than the total; the under wins when strictly less; it is a push when equal.
settlement_rules.tie_case: A push is recorded as neither a win nor a loss and leaves the denominator.

settlement_rules.rule: The home moneyline wins when the home club scores more points; the away moneyline wins when the away club scores more.
settlement_rules.tie_case: A tied game is void for moneyline grading: the bet is removed from both the numerator and the denominator. One tie exists in the feed (see the tie row).

settlement_rules.rule: A parlay wins only if every leg wins under the rules above. A push leg reduces the leg count rather than voiding the slip.
settlement_rules.tie_case: Stated so a reader can reproduce a graded parlay; no parlay is priced.

settlement_authority: Project rule for grading an originated line. No operator published a settlement rule to this project.
known_limits: One partial season; clubs have played eight or nine games.
Every row is a single-source reading of one NFL.com page.
The feed carries no price, so a graded row measures direction, never return.
Byes are carried from the capturing session and are not re-derived here.
